verdict.rationale: Helicone is an LLM observability platform, so human annotation queues are a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about annotation queues, human review workflows, or labeling. The closest items are webhooks that can trigger on filtered requests, automate workflows and score responses. These are generic integration hooks that would require building or bolting on a separate labeling system, so they do not demonstrate this capability.
